errors.cannotRevokeSelf: You cannot revoke your own super-admin role.
errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.

confirmGrant.title: Grant super-admin?
confirmGrant.description: {{email}} will gain full access to every organization and the admin API.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke super-admin?
confirmRevoke.description: {{email}} will lose access to /admin and machine-to-machine APIs.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{email}}?
confirmDelete.description: Removes the user from every organization and deletes all their sessions. Packages they uploaded remain.

fields.slugHelp: 3–32 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Becomes the URL prefix.
fields.name: Display name
fields.ownerPasswordHelp: Required if this email doesn't have an account yet.

confirmArchive.title: Archive {{slug}}?
confirmArchive.description: Members lose access. Composer clients get 404. Data is preserved and the org can be reactivated.

confirmHardDelete.title: Hard-delete {{slug}}?
confirmHardDelete.description: Irreversible. The org, members, tokens, and source configs will be removed. Refuses if packages exist.

confirmForce.title: {{slug}} still has packages.
confirmForce.description: Force-delete anyway? All packages, versions, and stored ZIPs will be destroyed.

confirmDelete.title: Force-delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: Irreversible. Removes all versions and ZIP files across the org.

tokens.title: Admin Tokens
tokens.copyOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again. Store it as the Bearer credential in your external service's environment.
tokens.name: Token Name
tokens.nameHelp: Used to identify which integration this token belongs to. Shown in the UI; not part of the token itself.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke admin token "{{name}}"?
confirmRevoke.description: Services using this token for the admin API will immediately start returning 401.
